meta.title: Vendor tries to accept after the evaluation time ended
gaps: Create or locate the specifically named RFQ in evaluation from the events list and send the counter offer near the end of its evaluation window
Wait for the evaluation window to end as a timed transition
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Create or locate the specifically named RFQ in evaluation from the events list and send the counter offer near the end of its evaluation window; Wait for the evaluation window to end as a timed transition

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ response state with the vendor's normal bid.
Create the buyer's counter offer on the vendor's own bid.
Verify that the counter offer is pending before the vendor attempts acceptance.
Attempt acceptance from the vendor side and require Procol to show that acceptance is refused after the round is closed.
Return to the buyer comparison grid to inspect the bid after the refused acceptance.
Verify the original bid price remains in the buyer's grid rather than being replaced by the counter offer.
